q: 医生___给病人检查身体，请你在外面等一下。
en: The doctor is examining a patient right now, so please wait outside.

q: 我妈妈现在___吃药，你过一会儿再打电话吧。
en: My mum is taking her medicine now, so call back in a while.

q: 他们也___用手机看比赛，没有人在看电视。
en: They are watching the match on their phones too, and nobody is watching TV.

q: 我的电脑___更新系统，现在不能用。
en: My computer is updating its system right now, so I can't use it.

q: 护士们都___给大家量体温，你们排好队，一个一个来。
en: The nurses are all taking everyone's temperature now, so line up and come one at a time.

q: 哥哥___修手机，你别去打扰他。
en: My brother is fixing his phone, so don't disturb him.

q: 我们___听医生讲怎么锻炼身体，请你们别说话。
en: We're listening to the doctor explain how to exercise, so please don't talk.

q: 别吵，爷爷睡觉___。
en: Don't make noise, Grandpa is sleeping.

q: 我给手机充电___，等一会儿再玩。
en: I'm charging my phone, I'll play in a bit.

q: 医生在办公室看病人___，你先坐一下。
en: The doctor is seeing a patient in the office, please sit for a moment.

q: 我在手机上订机票___，马上就好。
en: I'm booking a flight on my phone, it'll be done in a moment.

q: 小李在修电脑___，你过半个小时再找他。
en: Xiao Li is fixing a computer, come find him in half an hour.

q: 他正在网上跟客服聊天___，所以现在没空接电话。
en: He is chatting online with customer service right now, so he has no time to answer the phone.

q: 外面下雨___，你带一把伞吧。
en: It's raining outside, take an umbrella.

q: 我___在用手机，我在看书。
en: I'm not using my phone, I'm reading.

q: 你在打游戏吗？___，我在写作业。
en: Are you playing games? No, I'm doing my homework.

q: 弟弟没___看电视，他在玩手机。
en: My brother isn't watching TV, he's on his phone.

q: 医生现在___看病人，你可以进去。
en: The doctor isn't seeing patients right now, you can go in.

q: 昨天晚上你打电话的时候，我没___看比赛，我在洗衣服。
en: When you called last night I wasn't watching the match, I was doing laundry.

q: 手机没___充电，所以现在没电了。
en: The phone wasn't charging, so now it's out of battery.

q: 请相信我，我___看你的手机，是它突然亮了。
en: Believe me, I wasn't looking at your phone, it just lit up.

q: 他的手机没___响，是你的手机在响。
en: His phone isn't ringing, it's yours that is ringing.

q: 他进来的时候，我们___给老师发邮件。
en: When he came in, we were sending an email to the teacher.

q: 昨天晚上八点，我___看电视。
en: At eight o'clock last night I was watching TV.

q: 明天下午三点你来的时候，医生可能___给别的病人看病，请你等一下。
en: When you come tomorrow at three, the doctor may be seeing another patient, so please wait.

q: 昨天你来的时候，我正在看___电视，没听见门铃。
en: When you came yesterday I was watching TV and didn't hear the bell.

q: 开会的时候，小王正在玩___手机，被老板看见了。
en: During the meeting Xiao Wang was playing on his phone and the boss saw him.

q: 昨天你打电话来的时候，我正在医院排队挂___号，手机放在包里。
en: When you called yesterday I was queuing at the hospital to register, with my phone in my bag.

q: 昨天你发消息的时候，我___在开车，没有看手机。
en: When you sent a message yesterday I was driving, so I didn't look at my phone.

q: 他一直___等你，你快去吧。
en: He has been waiting for you all along, hurry up.

q: 已经十一点了，孩子还___玩手机。
en: It's already eleven and the child is still playing on the phone.

q: 他总是___看手机，从来不听我说话。
en: He is always on his phone and never listens to me.

q: 她每天早上都___跑步，身体越来越好。
en: She runs every morning and is getting healthier.

q: 医生一直___给那个病人做检查，到现在还没出来。
en: The doctor has been examining that patient the whole time and still hasn't come out.

q: 都半夜了，邻居还___打游戏，吵得我睡不着。
en: It's past midnight and the neighbour is still playing games, so noisy I can't sleep.

q: 妈妈经常___网上给奶奶买药。
en: Mum often buys medicine for Grandma online.

q: 李医生___办公室，他去楼下了。
en: Dr Li is not in the office, he went downstairs.

q: 他___家玩手机，你不用等他。
en: He's at home playing on his phone right now, no need to wait for him.

q: 小王呢？他___图书馆，你去那儿找他吧。
en: Where's Xiao Wang? He's at the library, go find him there.

q: 你的手机___桌子上，我刚才看到了。
en: Your phone is on the desk, I saw it just now.

q: 我弟弟现在___健身房锻炼，晚上七点才回来。
en: My brother is working out at the gym now and won't be back until seven.

q: 我___认识那个医生，他是我朋友。
en: I know that doctor, he's my friend.

q: 他现在___时间，你可以给他打电话。
en: He has time now, you can call him.

q: 我___很喜欢这个手机游戏，每天都玩。
en: I really like this phone game, I play it every day.

q: 她___觉得这个手机太贵了，所以没买。
en: She thinks this phone is too expensive, so she didn't buy it.

q: 弟弟现在___大学生，学的是医学。
en: My brother is a university student now, studying medicine.

q: 你看，这个孩子___像他爸爸。
en: Look, this child looks like his dad.

q: 他___知道你生病了，所以才给你买了药。
en: He knows you are ill, which is why he bought you medicine.

q: 我现在___有三个问题想问医生。
en: I have three questions for the doctor right now.

q: 我正在看___一部电影，还没看完。
en: I'm watching a film and haven't finished it.

q: 她正在做___检查，请不要进去。
en: She is having a check-up right now, please don't go in.

q: 我在写___作业，你别打电话。
en: I'm doing my homework, don't call.

q: 我玩___三个小时手机___，眼睛很累。
en: I've been on my phone for three hours and my eyes are tired.

q: 我等___你二十分钟___，你怎么才来？
en: I've been waiting for you for twenty minutes, why are you only coming now?

q: 他们正在网上聊___天，你不要打扰。
